---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new feature or improvement
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement, needs-triage
assignees: ''
---

## Problem

What problem does this solve, or what's missing today? (Not "what" you want
built yet — start with the underlying need.)

## Proposed solution

Describe the feature/change you'd like. If it touches the API, sketch the
endpoint/request/response shape; if it touches the schema, sketch the
table/column.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you thought about and why you prefer this one.

## Scope check

- [ ] I've checked [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](../../docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) and
      [docs/AI_PIPELINE.md](../../docs/AI_PIPELINE.md) and this fits the
      existing design (or I'm explicitly proposing to change it)
- [ ] I've checked the [Roadmap section of the README](../../README.md) —
      this isn't already planned

## Additional context

Anything else — mockups, related issues, links.
